evidence: Node-level HPO/Reactome/STRING counts improve the fair per-positive RGCN from macro AUPRC 0.1301 / micro 0.1419 to 0.3118 / 0.2186
observation: Adding HPO/Reactome/STRING counts as node features before message passing lifted the fair per-positive RGCN from 0.130120/0.141856 to 0.311756/0.218556 (macro AUROC 0.329 to 0.698). GATv2 stayed at 0.099447/0.102385 and GraphSAGE was unchanged, so the histogram at 0.683398 still leads; recorded as F-0033.
subject: F-41
title: Node-level external counts partially rescue the fair RGCN
